audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Heimerdinger the First-item and two-item stages and called level 6 even, while its own whys say 'Feast executes him', 'tank HP lets you lock him out' and 'unkillable in the 1v1'. It also sat on TRICKY 7.5/10 against a 57.42% Cho'Gath win rate.
audit.why: Heimerdinger owns 1-2 on turret plus 1325-range rockets against a 950-range Rupture. Level 3 is a coin-flip. From 4-5 Vorpal Spikes cone clear ends hand-farming, and from 6 a point-blank true-damage Feast kills a dashless ranged mage outright.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Skill / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath; difficulty re-rated FAV 5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. The full layer named no cooldown at all and the level-6 line was the generic 'Heimerdinger's ultimate changes the math too'.
audit.why: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11s, Hextech Micro-Rockets 11/10/9/8/7s, UPGRADE!!! 100/85/70s and Feast 80/70/60s. UPGRADE!!! at 100s rank 1 is the biggest single window in the lane and was never mentioned.
audit.corrected: Grenade 11s, rockets 11s, UPGRADE!!! 100s and Feast 80s now appear in the phase, cooldown and interaction fields with concrete sequencing.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never named a single Heimerdinger ability — it used the invented shorthand 'CH-2 Grenade' and nothing else — and it treated the grenade as a flat stun.
audit.why: Riot's text is specific: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade stuns only whoever is hit directly and merely slows the units around them, so clipping the edge instead of the centre is the difference between a stun and a slow. The decisive positive interaction is Feral Scream (11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, 300 cone): silenced, he cannot replant H-28 G Evolution Turret, cannot grenade away and cannot cast UPGRADE!!!, and he has no dash, so Rupture's knockup plus the silence is a commit with no exit. Range asymmetry matters too — rockets reach 1325, Rupture only 950.
audit.corrected: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade stuns only on a direct hit — clip the edge and it is just a slow. Silence stops replants.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer's early, mid, late and five of seven whys are written in the first person ('my early is the only rough patch', 'I own this 1v1', 'before my Rupture-Feral Scream combo exists').
audit.why: The page speaks in second person to the player everywhere else; first-person text reads as another champion's page bleeding through.
audit.corrected: early, mid, late and whys[1], whys[2], whys[3], whys[5], whys[6] converted to second person.
